output_semantics.scope: One current suitability family per proposal; separate proposals for distinct contexts.
output_semantics.piecewise: Strictly increasing [input, score] points. Linear interpolation between points; below/above explicitly null or authored score. Exact endpoints use their point score.
output_semantics.ranked_classes: Explicit string class-to-score map. Unknown classes and missing values return null.
output_semantics.threshold: Declared lt/le/gt/ge comparison, threshold, pass and fail scores. Missing values return null. Gate use requires an explicit exclusion rationale.
output_semantics.qualitative: Text-only interpretation with a calibration hold; not packageable as a calibrated mapping.
output_semantics.weights: Optional authored criterion weight, never inferred from source importance or support counts. A mapping package is not a complete T4_RUN policy.
output_semantics.acceptance: Original authenticated human issue, exact proposal/input/skill/row bytes; append-only acceptance and hold history.
output_semantics.freshness: Any changed candidate, source, review, definition or contract makes the proposal stale; a new proposal is required.
output_semantics.context_overrides: Separate mappings with explicit context identities. This version does not infer precedence or combine overlapping contexts.
output_semantics.logistic: Increasing 20/80 logistic at explicit x20/x80; finite real domain, stable exponential tails.
output_semantics.log_logistic: Increasing 20/80 logistic in log input; positive anchors, zero maps to zero, negatives invalid.
output_semantics.composite_scoping: Typed nested minimum; named component screens separate from score; temperature-only monthly interpolation; explicit subpractice/pathway scope; unknown and conditional water states; no inferred weight or score cutoff.
output_semantics.precomputed_unit_index: Identity native [0,1] score conditional on positive source area; zero/zero model-ineligible, missing unknown, mismatch invalid. Whole source km2 times100; partial units bounds0..source hectares without prorating. No score-weighted hectares.
output_semantics.draft_candidates: Pending candidate records permit representation review only. They never substitute for adopted definitions, eligible EV, original human scientific acceptance or runtime implementation.

profile_contract.thermal_calendar: 365-day no-leap, month-centre periodic linear interpolation; all days meeting explicit ge threshold
profile_contract.publication_gate: Official mappings still require adopted VONT/T1/preferred BIND for every input and derived quantity, exact family/subpractice scope and eligible evidence. Draft candidate refs are not EV.

lifecycle.evidence_refs: Nonempty provenance references with public HTTP(S) URLs; never substitutes for EV or admission receipts.
lifecycle.official_rows: Full existing proposal, adopted-definition, reviewed-evidence and authenticated human acceptance gates remain. Numeric held profiles with unresolved definitions remain outside the official route.

field_rules.unknown_fields: Reject all undeclared fields in profiles, nodes, input definitions, scope, screens, derivation, candidate, justification and source references.
field_rules.scope: Nonempty list supports multiple NbS in draft. Each exact nbs/family has nonempty unique subpractice/pathway lists. Only precomputed unit index may explicitly use null subpractice/pathway lists. Official proposals restrict to one current family and registered subpractices.
field_rules.inputs: Nonempty named quantity map including derived outputs. Nonempty variable,dataset_id,unit; finite increasing [minimum,maximum] valid_range. Physical-unit numeric inputs only; booleans/nonfinite/out-of-domain invalid, never clipped. Absent/null unknown.
field_rules.scores: Profile unit dimensionless and missing null. Increasing logistic or log-logistic 20/80 anchors; minimum propagates unknown. No arbitrary expressions, multiplication or compensating means.
field_rules.screens: Unique nonempty IDs; input must be a scored scalar quantity; operator lt/le/gt/ge, finite threshold, boolean water_bypass. Thermal screens cannot be water-bypassed. No inferred combined-score screen.
field_rules.composite_policy: water_policy conditional_unscored; combined_score_cutoff null; weight null; official weight_default null.
field_rules.thermal: Null or kind periodic_monthly_temperature_season; input,mean_output,days_output are distinct declared quantities with units degC,degC,days. Fixed month_lengths [31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31]; operator ge; finite authored threshold; empty_season_score numeric0. Values contain exactly12 monthly physical temperatures. Day-number centres start+(month_length+1)/2, periodic linear interpolation to days1..365. Count all qualifying days, no moisture/snow filter. Complete empty season: mean null,duration0,mean membership0; missing month: both metrics unknown. Derived values cannot be supplied.
field_rules.precomputed: Exactly two inputs, same dataset_id/release: dimensionless score range[0,1]; source area unitkm2 with nonnegative valid_range. area_to_hectares100; area_policy whole_units_partial_bounds_no_prorating. Identity score when sourcearea>0. Zero score iff zeroarea; mismatch invalid. No rescale,clipping,polygon prorating or score-weighted hectares.

context.caller_obligations: Pinned-release unit identity; union overlapping AOIs first and exclude boundary-only touches. Geometry/topology/coverage QA separate. Duplicate units rejected; no inferred polygon allocation.

additional_keys.derived: Composite derived mean/day values; empty object without thermal derivation.
additional_keys.data_state: Preserves unknown/invalid/zero unit-data state when an existing exclusion prevails.

result.outside_scope: No score,area or climate exclusion for missing/mismatched subpractice/pathway.
result.priority: Existing host/legal exclusion prevails even with missing component/unit data. Composite non-bypassable screens then conditional mapped water then bypassable dry screens then missing climate, unresolved host/legal, unresolved water context, eligible default rainfed.
result.water: Mapped refuge requires evidence reference, always unscored and no automatic eligible area. Unknown water context retains climate score but is climate_pass_water_context_unresolved, not default rainfed eligibility.
result.unit_area: Zero/zero is no_modelled_restorable_area (score null, source hectares0), not ecological impossibility. Missing is unknown; missing geometry unknown_geometry; invalid geometry invalid_geometry. Positive whole eligible units get sourcekm2×100; partial units pointestimate null, lower0,upper source hectares. Unresolved/excluded gates add no automatic eligible area.
result.score_meaning: Membership or native relative ease, never probability or suitable-area fraction. Climate reference evaluator computes no hectares.

structured_boundary_coverage: composites: all named screens,conditional water,and known empty thermal season if applicable
